title: System architecture
outcomes: an architecture review naming boundaries, coupling, failure modes, and reversibility
an architecture decision record a later reader can audit
inputs: the design, diagram, or decision under review
the confirmed architectural boundaries and invariants
the systems and data the design touches
minimumEvidence: every boundary, dependency, and data-ownership claim cites a document, diagram, or code component; a claimed property nobody measured is marked unmeasured
escalation: a design that changes who may reach what, or moves sensitive data, is handed to security-privacy
a decision whose reversal cost exceeds what the person has accepted is raised as a decision, not made
